name: 빈 통의 소류
quote: 채워지지 않는 허기가 너의 숨을 앗아리리라.
face: 눈이 없는 매끄러운 앞부분과 입에서 새어 나오는 독기
outfit: 황금색 화려한 장식구가 박힌 비단 천 띠
silhouette: 항아리처럼 불룩하고 거대한 몸체, 하단으로 갈수록 좁아지는 형태, 뒤로 길게 뻗은 갈라진 촉수 꼬리, 몸 주변을 떠다니는 황금 장식 입자
signature_motion: 느릿하게 몸을 흔들며 독 안개를 뿜어내는 움직임
signature_vfx: 두 겹으로 퍼져나가는 연두색 독성 탄막과 바닥을 덮는 보라색 독 장판
visual_en: A massive, pot-shaped larva-like body with a bloated, bloated purple and deep violet skin, featuring bright golden spots and lavish golden ornaments wrapped around its midsection. The creature has a thick, segmented tail ending in a split, fleshy tentacle. A bright neon lime-green fluid drips from its mouth area, contrasting with the dark purple body. Golden chains and large, glowing emerald gemstones are embedded in its skin. Around its heavy body, a radiant golden aura and floating golden particles drift slowly. The creature faces right, presenting a heavy, imposing silhouette with a thick, segmented tail.
features_en: Splits into 4 small Changrang upon death
pose_en: Slowly undulating forward with a heavy, menacing presence.
vfx_en: Two layers of expanding lime-green toxic projectiles and a spreading violet poisonous ground puddle.
lore: 정원 보스. 돌진하지 않고 느리게 밀고 온다. 독 탄막을 두 겹으로 쏘고 독 장판을 자주 넓게 깐다. 쓰러지면 작은 창랑 4마리로 갈라진다.

anim_notes.skill: firing two layers of poison bullets
anim_notes.ultimate: slamming a glowing warning circle onto the ground and summoning minions
anim_notes.vfx: a glowing red warning circle on the ground
anim_notes.death: splitting apart into four small creatures

frame_notes.death_1: the moment the body explodes into four separate round purple blobs flying apart in four directions with clear gaps between them; the body is no longer one piece and nothing lies on the ground
